summary:
We developed a 3D spatial, architecture, and interior design game that allows players to plan floor layouts, construct buildings, and decorate virtual living spaces.  
In the real world, learning architectural and interior design is often challenging due to expensive materials, complex professional software, and the high cost of mistakes. Our game solves this problem by providing an easy-to-use, grid-based modular building system where players can experiment with room proportions, lighting, textures, and furniture placement in a completely risk-free environment.  
This project is important because it makes spatial planning and creative design accessible, fun, and educational for beginners. It helps players build practical problem-solving skills, visualize their ideas in 3D, and understand how thoughtful design improves everyday spaces.

Project Name: Imperium: Crusade of the Four Genre: Grimdark Sci-Fi Grand Strategy & Tactical Squad RPG

What It Does & How It Works

Imperium: Crusade of the Four is a Warhammer 40,000-inspired strategy and tactical warfare game where players command the forces of Humanity in a galactic crusade against encroaching alien (Xenos) empires. Unlike conventional strategy games where players control a single army type, this project combines macro-level galactic exploration with micro-level armor engineering and simultaneous four-legion tactical command:

  • Four-Legion Tactical Synergy: Players deploy and coordinate four distinct Imperial Chapters in every battle—combining their specialized combat doctrines to defeat overwhelming enemy numbers:
    • Ironclad Vanguard: Heavy siege specialists that form immovable defensive lines with artillery support and fortified armor bonuses.
    • Void Hawks: High-mobility jump-pack infantry and orbital drop-pod shock troops built for rapid flanking and critical ambush strikes.
    • Pyreborne Zealots: Close-quarters assault squads equipped with flamers, melta guns, and chainswords to purge massive alien swarms.
    • Aegis Wardens: Keepers of relic plasma weaponry, Dreadnought walkers, and psychic Librarian powers that shield allies and disrupt enemy formations.
  • The Forge of Mars (Modular Armor & Wargear Customization): Between missions, players enter an Adeptus Mechanicus foundry to design custom Power Armor loadouts—swapping Mark VI, VII, and X helmets, pauldrons, chest plates, servo-arms, and Chapter heraldry. Each component dynamically alters squad weight, movement speed, armor rating, and energy capacity.
  • Fortress-Monastery Base Building: On liberated worlds, players build and upgrade gothic planetary strongholds—including Manufactorums (resource production), Void-Shield Generators (orbital bombardment defense), Orbital Defense Batteries (off-map battleship fire support), and Librarius Sanctums (psychic research).
  • Galactic Crusade & Space Hulk Exploration: Players navigate a holographic Milky Way star chart along warp-route lanes to secure supply lines, intercept Xenos invasion fleets, and board drifting derelict Space Hulks in fog-of-war dungeon crawls to recover lost Standard Template Construct (STC) blueprints.

Benefits & Intended Impact

  • High Strategic Replayability: By pitting four synergistic human legions against four asymmetric Xenos factions (Tyranids, Orks, Necrons, and Aeldari)—each featuring unique tactical behaviors such as adaptive bio-resistances or stealth ambushes—players are encouraged to experiment with diverse armor builds and squad combinations rather than relying on a single dominant strategy.
  • Instant Browser-Based Accessibility: Packaging the game design architecture into an interactive web-based tactical command deck allows players and judges to customize power armor, upgrade bases, chart star systems, and test four-legion skirmishes directly in any web browser without large downloads or high-end gaming hardware.

Tools, Coding Languages, Hardware & Software Used

  • Frontend & Interactive Prototype: Developed as a self-contained, zero-dependency web application using HTML5, CSS3 (custom grimdark gothic HUD styling, responsive grid layouts, and animations), Vanilla JavaScript (ES6+) for game-state simulation, resource economy, and combat resolution, and Inline SVG for dynamic armor hologram rendering.
  • Concept Art & Gameplay Visualization: Created 7 widescreen (16:9) gameplay preview renders illustrating tactical squad combat, the armor customization hangar, planetary fortress building, the galactic war room star chart, Space Hulk corridor exploration, orbital battleship strikes, and boss duels using AI Image Generation tools.
  • AI-Assisted Design & Engineering: Used Gemini to structure the asymmetric faction mechanics, balance gameplay loops, generate visual previews, and build the interactive web prototype.
  • Hardware: Standard development workstation/laptop capable of running modern web browsers and local code editors.

Creativity & Key Factors Considered by Our Team

  • Creative Innovation: The core creative twist is orchestrated multi-legion command paired with granular armor engineering. Rather than forcing players to choose between slow tanks or fast raiders, players command all four archetypes simultaneously—using the Ironclad Vanguard to anchor the front line while Void Hawks drop behind enemy ranks and Aegis Wardens provide psychic cover.
    • Meaningful Tactical Counter-Play: Enemy Xenos factions were designed to actively punish repetitive player tactics (e.g., Tyranids evolving resistance to overused weapons; Necrons stripping heavy armor), keeping the armor customization system essential throughout the campaign.
    • Cohesive Grimdark UI/UX: Balanced authentic gothic-industrial visual immersion (gold, crimson, and slate tactical interfaces) with clean, intuitive controls that remain readable across desktop and mobile screens.
    • Zero-Friction Deployment: Engineered the interactive prototype as a lightweight standalone web application (index.html) so anyone can launch, test, and evaluate the project immediately via a public URL.
